name: 連絡先CSV取込の4段階プログレスステッパー
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied HubSpot import progress stepper as a faithful Japanese localization. The source crop is 1460x64 pixels (22.81:1), an ultra-wide, shallow horizontal strip. Keep all four steps on one line and include the small progress text at the far right edge. No mapping table or surrounding dialog content.

Show four evenly distributed step markers and labels from left to right: 「種類」, 「アップロード」, 「マッピング」, 「詳細」. The first two steps are complete: filled coral-orange circles with white checkmarks and a coral-orange connector line. The third step, 「マッピング」, is current: white circle with a coral-orange outline, attached to the orange completed line. The fourth step, 「詳細」, is pending: white circle with a thin light-gray outline. The connector from the current step to the fourth is pale gray. Align each label centered under its marker in dark gray.

At the extreme right, include the small muted text 「ステップ 3 / 4」, positioned and clipped slightly at the crop edge as in the source. Preserve the original wide spacing, fine 2-pixel horizontal line, small 28-pixel circles, restrained coral accent, and compact 64-pixel-high strip. No cards, large whitespace, extra steps, added buttons, or map content. Preserve the 1460x64 aspect without blank bands and use the crop as authority for exact state and alignment.
reviewNotes: v001 preserves the four import steps, Type/Upload completed states, Map current state, Details pending state and Step 3 / 4 label. However, it is 1891x831 (2.27:1) with large blank bands instead of the source 1460x64 (22.81:1). Previous wide-strip attempts repeatedly failed to hold their ratio and second reframing did not help, so recorded needs-correction after one evidence-based attempt.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
